explication: KityMinder is a browser-based SVG mind-map editor. Users create and edit a map through the UI, which operates on the mind-map model and renders it; the README also documents cloud synchronization and link sharing. The repository includes protocol handlers and a PHP-based native-format export path. Core implementation relationships are only partially sampled, so the graph limits call-level claims to relationships visible in excerpts or explicitly documented in the README; some feature branches are shown without speculative links.
